contexts.text: There is nothing in the universe which does not relate to good, and to truth: everything which is of use and life, relates to good...
Each and all things relate to the good which is of love, and to the truth which is of intelligence.
All things of Heaven and the Church relate to goods and truths: the things of love and charity to goods, and the things of faith to truths.
Good relates to the will; truth to the understanding.
Good and truth are what all things in the universe relate to. The things which do not relate to them are not in Divine order; and those which do not relate to both together do not produce anything.

For everything relates to good and truth; for there is nothing in the world which does not relate to both: what man loves relates to the good with him; and what instructs him about good... relates to truth.
For there are two things to which all things in the universe relate; namely, good and truth, or, what is the same, love and faith.
For there is nothing in the universe which does not relate as to quality either as to good or as to truth.
To relate the words to Jehovah () = correspondence and thence conjunction.

All things in the universe relate to good and truth. AC 9186:3. AC 9206:end. AC 9279:2, Explained. AC 9297:2. AC 9514. AC 10645:4. HH 9:2. HH 203:2. DLW 31, Explained. DP 5. DP 157:6, Explained. DP 168:2. CL 60. ISB 7. TCR 38. TCR 336. TCR 660. AE 1004:2. AE 1026:3.
Everything in the universe relates to the truth which is from good.
In the Grand Man relate to...
The staves relate to the arms...
All things in the Spiritual World relate to such things as are with man, because Heaven relates to one man.
The things on man's right side relate to the good from which is truth; and those on the left relate to the truth which is from good.
The representatives in nature relate to the human form; and, according to the relation to it, have a signification. AC 9634. AC 9643:2.
All things in the universe... relate to both good and to truth in order to be anything. Explained. AC 9955:2. AC 10137.
All things in Heaven relate to good and the derivative truth; and all things in Hell relate to evil and the derivative falsity. The same in man. Explained.
For each and all things with man relate to truths and their perceptions and affections...
Form relates to truth; for truth is the form of good. Hence all things in the universe... which are in Divine order, relate to good and truth. NJHD 11, Explained.
The things which correspond to Heaven all relate to good and truth; and those which correspond to Hell, to evil and falsity.
All the delights relate to the reigning love.
So all things which are contrary to Divine order relate to evil and falsity. NJHD 20, References.

Spiritual truths cannot be comprehended unless (it) is known, first: That all things in the universe relate to good and truth, and to their conjunction, in order to be anything; thus to love and faith, and their conjunction.
It does not matter.
So all things with man relate to the will and the understanding.
That all things which have been created, in a certain image relate to a man. General article. DLW 319, Explained. DLW 330.
That all things of the mind relate to the will and understanding, and all things of the body to the heart and lungs. Explained.
All things which proceed from the (spiritual) Sun... relate to a man.
An Angel related to me...
To which all things of the Word relate.
Each and all things must relate to two universals... This relation effects that...
God 8. 8. Each and all things... must relate to One...
